title: Models
description: model/models.json: named models of one project (perspectives): each a subset of the project's model tables and measures for one audience or subject (e.g. Finance, Marketing). Joins and measures stay those of model/model.json and model/measures.json, so numbers never differ between models. A report or a query that names a model may use only its tables (and the date table) and measures.

tables.description: Model tables in this model; the date table is always included

measures.description: Measure IDs in this model; empty or missing: every measure over its tables
